fusions.name: Lancing Thrust
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and draws one of them out through the staff, using it up. The thrust reaches a target up to 4 tiles away and deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Wormwood Arc
fusions.desc: Sweeps the staff through a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 11 damage to everything in it and leaves each target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Drawn Through the Grain
fusions.desc: You spin the staff in a guard for 9 seconds. Each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Bracing Draught
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions lifts, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
